当用户问到氢分子医学、富氢产品、氢水机、氢氧馆、氢中药、固态氢、足浴氢气片、
氢眼贴、氢护肤、氢养生馆运营、私域选品、B端招商、品牌贴牌、实体店获客、
大健康产业分析、氢农业、银发经济×氢健康、康复辅助器具政策等问题时触发。
覆盖人群：氢健康从业者/研究者、氢氧馆老板、氢气机厂家、品牌方、
私域选品方、养生馆/理疗馆/中医馆/美容院/产康中心实体店老板。
skills.name: 氢分子医学健康

skills.description: Identify and mask sensitive government data based on the DB34 standard. Activates when users ask to mask data, desensitize datasets, anonymize personal information, or apply DB34 standards. Triggers on phrases like data masking, sensitive data, masking strategy, PII, government data, 脱敏, 政务数据, 数据脱敏, 静态脱敏, 动态脱敏, 掩码, 截断, 泛化. Supports identifying sensitive columns and applying standard-compliant masking techniques (masking, truncation, generalization, hashing). Uses Python to process CSV/JSON files and apply rule-based data transformations.
skills.description_zh: 基于DB34数据脱敏标准 技能
skills.name: db34-data-masking-skill 数据脱敏标准

skills.description: Use when the user wants to generate DESIGN.md or design.md from a webpage URL by running a local, rule-based design token extraction script. The skill opens the user-provided URL with Playwright, samples computed styles locally, infers colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows, and basic components, then writes AI-coding-friendly design documentation without model API calls.

skills.description: Through built-in cameras of smart feeders or fixed cameras on aquariums, the system captures fish feeding videos after feeding. Using AI object detection and motion analysis, it identifies the number of fish gathering for food, feeding intensity (fish swimming speed, feeding action frequency), and remaining feed amount, and computes a comprehensive feeding activity score (0-100). | 通过智能喂食器内置摄像头或鱼缸固定摄像头，在投喂后拍摄鱼群摄食视频，利用 AI 目标检测和运动分析技术，识别鱼群聚集抢食的数量、摄食强度（鱼只游动速度、摄食动作频率）以及剩余饲料量，综合计算摄食活跃度评分（0-100 分）。当活跃度评分低于阈值时，输出'食欲下降'提示，可能预示疾病、水质恶化或应激反应。
